title: Sleep Disordered Breathing, Endothelial Function, and Adverse Events in Pregnancy
official: SLEEP: Sleep Disordered Breathing, Endothelial Function, and Adverse Events in Pregnancy
summary: This is a prospective longitudinal cohort study whereby pregnant individuals are asked to complete an 8-day testing protocol to measure their sleep and cardiovascular health at two timepoints during pregnancy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* over 18 years of age
* pregnant (20-24 weeks gestation at enrollment)

Exclusion Criteria:

* worked shift work past 11pm in the previous month
* previously diagnosed with a sleep disorder by a physician

sites.f: Program for Pregnancy and Postpartum Health, University of Alberta
